briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.2%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on catalyst. Several candidates showed bullish RSI and MACD crossovers, but none combined all four confirmation signals (including a volume surge) needed for a high-conviction entry, so we held our 7 existing positions and kept the 3 open slots in cash rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above key moving averages, AND a volume surge — to line up together before buying, rather than acting on just one or two. Today several stocks showed some bullish signals but lacked the volume surge that suggests real institutional buying, so no new positions were opened.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前，等待多項技術訊號同時出現——例如MACD黃金交叉、健康的RSI水平、股價站上關鍵均線，以及成交量放大——而非僅憑一兩項訊號就進場。今日雖有部分股票出現部分利多訊號，但缺乏顯示機構資金真正進場的成交量放大訊號，因此未開新倉。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded roughly flat today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 each dipping about 0.2%. This kind of muted, directionless session typically reflects investors waiting for clearer catalysts rather than reacting to a specific shock. Without a strong move in either direction, momentum-based systems generally sit tight rather than chase marginal setups.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢大致持平，納斯達克指數與標普500指數皆微跌約0.2%。這種缺乏方向性的溫和交易日，通常反映投資人在等待更明確的市場訊號，而非對特定利空消息作出反應。在缺乏明顯多空傾向的情況下，動能導向的操作策略一般會選擇按兵不動，而非勉強追逐邊際訊號。
